problem: If $\overset{―}{X}={2.1,\pi ,\sqrt{7},11}$ and $\overset{―}{Y}={2,\pi ,11},$ then what is $\overset{―}{X\cup Y}?$
worked_solution:
De Morgan's law for unions states that

$$
\overset{―}{X\cup Y}≡\overset{―}{X}\cap \overset{―}{Y}.
$$

So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{X\cup Y} & =\overset{―}{X}\cap \overset{―}{Y} \\  & ={2.1,\pi ,\sqrt{7},11}\cap {2,\pi ,11} \\  & ={\pi ,11}.\end{aligned}
$$
